dataContract.writeFreeze: stop both pointer watchers before import or rollback
dataContract.snapshot: copy the exact legacy Data value into the transaction record's protected recovery payload
dataContract.rollbackLimit: new settings remain backward-readable because the schema matches the legacy Store shape

healthChecks: exactly one pointer watcher is active
the imported corner assignments decode successfully
an assigned corner opens the selected test app once
the same corner cannot fire twice until the pointer leaves its release zone

retirement.availability: production migration after verified replacement health
retirement.userApplication: move to Trash only after the Switchboard watcher and imported settings verify
retirement.restoreSource: owner-only verified original and bridge archives plus recoverable Trash copies
